scientific_integrity: Theorem proven analytically and checked with supplementary exact-rational code; no claim of independent audit or established publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one noiseless evaluation of each fidelity with known independent Brownian-bridge components; the finite-ratio non-collocation theorem holds for all d>0, but two-point global uniqueness and expansions only for sufficiently large d; no explicit cutoff or multi-sample extrapolation.
title: Sharp non-collocation and a golden-ratio limit in two-fidelity Brownian-bridge quadrature
